reviews.title: Great idea! Not executed
reviews.text: I loved the description of this app and all the things it says you can do. My problem is all the ads that get stuck. So many say you can do this… if you watch an ad. I hit to watch the ad and 10 minutes later, my phone is still on that ad. No X showed up to close it. If I touch the screen anywhere, it just takes me to the App Store to buy it. If I close that, I’m right back to where I was stuck. I have to close the whole app to get out of it, thus losing whatever insensitive I had watched the ad to receive. It’s very frustrating. I would use more and recommend to my walking friends if this wasn’t an issue. Otherwise, I think it’s a great idea and cool how you can walk to Paris and other locations with your distance.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
I love the design and simplicity of the app. Using it feels cozy and simple and the Macadam Spots encourage me to explore new places and change my routes. The events are awesome as well and provide a fun goal to work towards by collecting event items on the map.

I have a few issues and suggestions that I would also like to share. Firstly, the map feature does not seem to automatically pick up coins even when the app is open which is a bit frustrating since it causes me to be looking down at my phone more than I would like. Secondly, I am an inline skater and unfortunately inline skating barely gets counter for steps compared to walking and running. It would be awesome if there were ways to get steps for other activities like cycling, skating, etc.

Overall I really enjoy the app. It encourages me to get outside more and makes me feel rewarded for doing so.

reviews.title: DON’T WASTE YOUR TIME!!
reviews.text: It takes months to even be eligible to redeem points and support will not help fix your issue when there are tech issues. The only thing I liked about the app was the interface and that it has less ads than most of the other walking apps. Ultimately I used the app consistently for 3 months averaging 7k steps/day and I wasn’t anywhere near the redemption threshold for a reward. After the app glitched and didn’t give me my points and I lost my streak and support was no help, I deleted the app. Also the streak repair cost way too many coins for how many you can even earn in a month.

reviews.title: Impossible to redeem rewards
reviews.text: I am updating my review to one star, since in recent weeks the app has made it impossible to redeem any rewards. They only have an open period one time per week to withdraw coins, and in that period I tried several times leading up to the window to withdraw, only to receive “Error” messages and have the window update to 7 days in the future after about 5 seconds. The developers need to resolve this for anyone to be able to gain any value out of using this app. I have over $120 in cash out rewards pending and can’t redeem any of it, and the idea that users have to bend their entire schedules around a 5 second window once per week (only to still not be able to redeem anything) is ridiculous. Please fix this asap.
